warn.title: WARNING
warn.body: This game contains sudden scares, flashing lights, blood and disturbing images. If you have photosensitive epilepsy, turn on “Reduce flashes” in Options.
warn.headphones: Wear headphones. Play in the dark.
credits.body:
LAST SEEN — demo

Made 100% in code: Three.js, Web Audio and Canvas.
Fonts: Special Elite, VT323, Anton, Archivo Black, Caveat, Permanent Marker (SIL OFL).

All characters are fictional.
opt.title: OPTIONS
opt.brightnessHint: Raise brightness until the symbol is barely visible.
poster.title: MISSING
poster.subtitle: HAVE YOU SEEN THESE GIRLS?
poster.footer1: LAST SEEN AT SAN AURELIO SCHOOL
hint.camera: Hold [Right click] to use the camera · [Left click] Take a photo
hint.journal: [Tab] Journal — drag one clue onto another to connect them
hint.tape: There's a tape inside: “10/24”. [Left click] to play it.
door.locked2B: Jammed. Through the little window you can see the blackboard.
door.stuck: It's stuck. Hold [E] to force it.
door.lockerLocked: Locker 17. Half open. Something is holding it shut.
sms.1: i'm still at school. come. don't bring anyone.
sms.2: look at the floor. with the camera.
sms.rule: if you run, she runs. if you crouch, she waits.
sms.dont: don't come in. it's not me.
sub.tape2: “…and when the lights go out, nobody moves…”
journal.title: JOURNAL
journal.help: Drag one clue onto another to connect them. [Tab] to close.
clue.c1.d: Six girls. October 24, 9 PM. Lucía is the first one.
clue.c2.d: Wet, muddy. It was lying in the hallway.
clue.c3.d: “REHEARSAL 9 PM — DON'T MISS IT!”. I shot it through the glass.
clue.c4.d: Laughter. A rehearsal. Then a cut.
clue.c5.d: I recorded the room's silence. It wasn't empty.
clue.c6.d: On the back, in her handwriting: “don't trust my phone”.
deduce.rehearsal: They were all at the rehearsal. Inside room 2B.
deduce.code: Lucía left me the code: 6-3-1. The gym.
goal.follow: Follow the footprints only the camera can see.
goal.connect: Connect what I know in the journal.
goal.mirror: Look for something in the mirrors.
people.lucia: My sister. She was 16. She loved theater.
people.daniela: I found her ID. Her footprints are still wet.
people.renata: They say she used to stare at mirrors.
people.anapaula: She imitated everyone. It was her joke.
people.unknown: I don't know anything about her yet.

end.crashBody: “LAST SEEN” has stopped responding. You can wait for it to respond or exit the page.
